local.interpretation: Reaction input signature is a tuple of native first_idx, break_idx, mode, optional intrabar_start, box source indexes and str(box_top/bottom), optional anchor_idx and str(optional anchor_value). Representation and hashability are native; str(None) is retained, no as_tuple normalization, no full object identity.
LiveS continuation constructor owns an initially None scope, empty dependency set and empty decision dict, independent of detector; class docstring describes intent, not arbitrary-input proof.

Dependency set comprehends trend then opposite reactions, zero-based enumerate, native break index into candle_times and side, number, S44 signature. Timestamp is Break main open, not confirmation. Native set membership/hash/equality can fail; duplicates collapse.

Adds reset event and int(from_first_idx), reset-blue event and number from first-reset map, and public-blue event alone. Set update collapses duplicate equal entries; no full Blue or A record coverage is asserted.

Settlement begins at decision_event_time; Type3/4 return directly, otherwise native assert order_match, confirmation and lower-bound at max(confirmation,range_start); absence of any lower row at or before decision yields None. This is existence only, not a crossing or range_end test.

Extends through to Order Break main open; calls first trend reaction after Order confirmation even if actual route was Advanced or pre-Order; if aligned extends through to its Break main open and confirmation. No current Reaction identity claim beyond returned tuple.

Dirty admission inclusive zero to len(candles); no exact-integer check. Scope tuple direction/timeframe/start_index/range_start excludes end_index and input identity. Dirty is current main open at index or range_end at len. Current dependencies computed before scope comparison.

Same scope computes earliest timestamp from symmetric difference, default=dirty evaluated eagerly, then min with dirty. Reuses prior decisions dict reference; changed scope selects fresh empty dict. Current decisions always fresh.

Nested resolver builds order key None or (order[0],S44(order[1]),order[2]); A key ordinal,source_index,source_time,str(price),stop,order_key. Previous lookup only; strict previous settlement < dirty reuses exact tuple and S reference and inserts into current. Equality at frontier recomputes.

Miss resolves current detector candidate; nonnull only obtains settlement; stores pair only for nonnull settlement; returns result regardless of cacheability. None is not cached; no current lookup and no in-place S edit.

Always invokes detector._detect(resolve), including native audit/ownership clear/rebuild. Only successful return publishes scope/dependencies/current together, then returns output directly. Failure before publication retains old wrapper fields but detector/external aliases may already mutate; no rollback or shallow copy.
Public helper creates fresh SZoneDetector with supplied positional args then calls detect; no continuation cache. Native argument evaluation, constructor and detect failures propagate; output direct.
